claims.why: All accounts went from $364,166.99 to $473,086.15: +$108,919.16, +29.9%. No cause is stated.

claims.quote: Raw materials were up $42.8K (44%), mainly the Aerovane bracket program ramp, net of a $7.2K credit for out-of-tolerance bar.
claims.why: Raw materials went from $96,473.04 to $139,243.13: +$42,770.09, +44.3%. Three AV-220 purchase orders ($18,600 + $14,900 + $11,400 = $44,900; only the first memo says 'Aerovane') less the $7,200 RMA credit = $37,700, 88% of the change.

claims.quote: Direct labor rose about 10% as we built out the second shift for Aerovane.
claims.why: Direct labor went from $151,008.47 to $165,642.25: +$14,633.78, +9.7%. The weekly '2nd shift' payroll lines went from $24,781.64 to $39,707.09: +$14,925.45, 102% of the change.

claims.quote: Outside processing roughly doubled, mostly anodizing on the Aerovane brackets.
claims.why: Outside processing went from $11,400.00 to $22,800.00: +$11,400.00, +100.0%. Lakeshore Anodizing went from $9,000 to $20,400: +$11,400, 100%. The memo ('Anodize lots - Sep') does not name the customer; 'roughly doubled' is a percentage stated in words.

claims.quote: Machine maintenance jumped $18.3K: the Mill 3 spindle rebuild plus a full coolant system flush.
claims.why: Machine maintenance went from $1,868.51 to $20,185.31: +$18,316.80. Spindle rebuild $14,800 plus coolant flush $3,900 = $18,700, 102% of the change; routine service fell $383.20.

claims.quote: Shop supplies were up $3.9K for the coolant flush.
claims.why: Shop supplies went from $3,285.45 to $3,216.93: -$68.52. The coolant flush ($3,900) is booked to Machine Maintenance. The vendor, Crestline Industrial Fluids, also sells the monthly coolant concentrate that is booked to Shop Supplies (flat at $1,180).

claims.quote: Plant utilities rose $3.4K on summer peak-demand charges.
claims.why: Plant utilities went from $18,130.00 to $21,560.00: +$3,430.00, so the amount is right. The demand charge is $3,100 in both months. The increase is a $3,300 back-bill for a meter misread June-August (96%).

claims.quote: Quality costs rose $11.6K for the AS9100 surveillance audit.
claims.why: Quality & certification went from $600.00 to $12,200.00: +$11,600.00, so the amount is right. The AS9100D surveillance audit is $5,500, 47%; the larger part is the CMM recalibration and probe replacement ($6,100).

claims.quote: Inbound freight rose $6.5K because we had to air-freight stainless bar after the mill shipped late.
claims.why: Freight in went from $3,757.50 to $10,300.62: +$6,543.12. The SkyBridge expedite of 17-4 SS bar ($6,350) is 97%. The memo says 'SS', not 'stainless'.

claims.quote: Outbound freight was down about $1.5K on fewer customer shipments.
claims.why: Freight out went from $5,185.85 to $6,765.79: +$1,579.94, up, not down. Shipment count was the same (8); the cost per shipment rose with the Aerovane loads.

non_claims.quote: Shipments to Aerovane started on 9/22 and first article inspection passed; on-time delivery was 91% and scrap fell to 2.1%.
